description: 液化石油氣經銷業聯絡資訊 [fuel stations and oil and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 液化石油氣(桶裝瓦斯)為民生重要燃料，其產業鏈包含煉製業、經銷業、分裝業及零售業(瓦斯行)等階層，各階層亦成立相關公會。 本署依法進行產業之管理，如氣源流向、灌裝及銷售重量等，就全國經銷業家數已完成統計，為強化政府資訊之公開，爰提供業者之基本連絡資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
